Riverfolk say they are not a people so much as a habit of standing near moving water. Their hair takes the color of wet silt. Children learn to read a current before they learn to write their names.

They raised [[Ember Reach]] and still keep [[The Hearth Compact]], though some argue a guest-fire is a poor substitute for a river. [[Mira Vale]] is Riverfolk and does not argue. She draws both the absence and the old flood line.
